name.en: Lamello Clamex P-14 (P-System groove, lever access Ø6)

source: Lamello P-System brochure (EN) pp. 16-17, 72, 86: 14 mm deep P-System groove in both parts, 7 mm wide, ~69.6 mm long at the surface (disc cutter Ø100.4), centred in the board thickness; lever access hole Ø6, axis 7.5 from the joint face, from the inner face into the groove; first connector ≥ 37 from the end, ≤ 300 apart, butt joints from 15 mm. The groove's 9.8 mm undercut is not modelled. See docs/hardware-research/lamello-keku.json.
